--- pipe_aggregate_group_only.sql
FROM Sales
|> AGGREGATE GROUP BY category AS kind ASC, region DESC

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 10,
            Name:    "Sales",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeAggregate{
        Pipe:    11,
        GroupBy: &ast.PipeAggregateGroupBy{
          Group:  24,
          And:    -1,
          Order:  -1,
          By:     30,
          Lparen: -1,
          Rparen: -1,
          Items:  []*ast.PipeAggregateGroupByItem{
            &ast.PipeAggregateGroupByItem{
              DirPos: 50,
              Expr:   &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 33,
                NameEnd: 41,
                Name:    "category",
              },
              As: &ast.AsAlias{
                As:    42,
                Alias: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 45,
                  NameEnd: 49,
                  Name:    "kind",
                },
              },
              Dir: "ASC",
            },
            &ast.PipeAggregateGroupByItem{
              DirPos: 62,
              Expr:   &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 55,
                NameEnd: 61,
                Name:    "region",
              },
              Dir: "DESC",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM Sales |> AGGREGATE GROUP BY category AS kind ASC, region DESC
